subject.title: 飞书话题群(Topic Group)被识别为p2p导致消息路由错误

question: Which Feishu signal should OpenClaw trust to classify `chat_type: "p2p"` `oc_...` topic/OpenChat events as group traffic without breaking true p2p/direct paths?
rationale: Current code proves the bug, but repository history and tests show that prefix-only or root/thread-only heuristics can cross the DM/group authorization and session boundary; maintainers need to choose the permanent contract before automation changes routing.

options.title: Adopt a verified shared classifier
options.body: Require live or official-contract proof for the Feishu topic/OpenChat discriminator, then apply it in dispatch and mention-forward paths with direct-path regression tests.

options.title: Revise the external PR
options.body: Use the linked conflicting PR as source work, but replace the prefix-only rule with the maintainer-approved discriminator before merge.

options.title: Wait for stronger Feishu proof
options.body: Leave the issue open and ask for a redacted live webhook sample or upstream contract citation before deciding the classifier shape.

recommendation.title: Adopt a verified shared classifier
recommendation.body: Require live or official-contract proof for the Feishu topic/OpenChat discriminator, then apply it in dispatch and mention-forward paths with direct-path regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu topic-session commits and current routing-policy ownership make this the best available decision route from the inspected history.
